geo_aeo.answer_first_block: Zero-Trust Architecture (ZTA) in Microservices eliminates implicit trust within internal networks. Every service-to-service communication is continuously verified via mTLS (workload identity) and user token propagation rather than static API keys.
query_fan_out: What is Zero-Trust Architecture in microservices?
How do you implement mTLS for Go microservices?
How does SPIFFE/SPIRE work in a Zero-Trust setup?
How does user identity propagation differ from service authentication?
